source_basis.title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下册）》

major_findings: P01-401…418 were mislabelled as printed p15 in the historical candidate metadata. The scan shows they belong to printed p14 and duplicate P01-SG-144…152; they are explicitly dispositioned but not promoted twice.
P01-419…430 cover printed p15 Taiyin; P01-431…494 cover the full Tanlang section across printed pp15–16; P01-495…500 cover only the opening of Jumen and do not close the Jumen source span.

Fifteen source-backed omitted atoms were added: the Chen-Xu Taiyin marital outcome and generic hub, the four Si-Hai Taiyin branch outcomes/hubs, the Yin Tanlang penal-event branch, and the non-flowing-sha branch of the Fire/Bell Tanlang annual failure condition.
The scan reads the p15 lead-in glyph as “己亥太阴”; the source wording is preserved as printed while the following subclauses are scoped separately to 巳宫 and 亥宫. It is not silently rewritten to 巳亥.
Explicit “大运流年” hubs remain dual-layer DECADE + YEAR; generic “枢纽”, “流曜”, and “年运” remain unresolved where the source does not specify a layer.
Historical A2-R1 feedback markers are retained only as references to the existing path-dependent history schema; no new memory type or feedback-derived source rule was added.
P01-493 的具体年度“暴败之克应”归为 CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY；其无流煞再冲起的对照分支由 P01-SG-167 独立保留。

source_coverage_gaps_closed.closure_scope: 太阴主富/禄及卯酉、辰戌、己亥（原文字形）分支与枢纽；完整贪狼第9节
